paite: Huan Pharisaite leh laigelhmite lak a mi kuate hiam, Jerusalem a kipan akiang ah ahong kikhawm uhi.
heading: Thugousiah Thu A Dotna / (Mat 15.1-9)

paite: Huaite'n nungzui khenkhatte'n khut ninpi a tanghou anek uh amu ua, nin, chih tuh, sil lou, chihna ahi.
Pharisaite leh Judate tengteng in upate thugousiah apom tinten ziak un akhut uh hoihtak a asil kei uleh ane ngei kei uhi.
Dawr mun a kipan a apai un leng akisil phot kei uleh ane ngei kei uhi. Huan thugousiah dang tampi achin uh a-om, nou, bel, taubelte sil thute ah.
Huchi in Pharisaite leh laigelhmite'n, "Bang achia upate thugousiah bang a na nungzuite om lou a, khut ninpi a tanghou ne ahi ua," chi in adong uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Isai in nou milepchiahte thu a na genkhol dik hilhial ve, 'Hiai mite'n amuk un ahon zahtak ua, alungtang un hon gamlat uh' achi hi.
'Mihing thupiakte asinsak lel ziak un ahon biak uh athawn ahi,' chih gelh bang in.
"Pathian thupiakte nelhsiah in mihing thugousiah na len tinten ua ei ve," achi hi.
Akiang uah, "Na thugousiah uh na zuihtheihna ding ua Pathian thupiakte na deih louh uh zaw, lem na thei hial ve ua.
Mosi in, 'Na nu leh na pa zahtak in,' 'Kuapeuh anu hiam apa hiam gensia si mahmah hen,' achi a;
nou hichibang in na chi ua, mi'n, anu hiam, apa hiam kiang a, 'Na hon phatuampihna ding Korban ahita,' achih, (huai tuh Pathian kiang a piak, chihna ahi),
Anu a ding hiam, apa a ding hiam in bangmah hihsak na phal nawn kei nak uh.
Na thugousiah uh na piak sawnsawnna un Pathian thu bangmah lou na suah uhi; huai bang thil tampi na hih uh," achi hi.
Huan mipite asam nawn a, akiang uah, "Na vek un ka thu ngaikhia unla, theisiam un;
heading: Mihing Hihninte / (Mat 15.1-9)

paite: mihing polam a kipan asung a lut amah hihnin thei bangmah a-om kei; mihing sung a kipan a hong pawt, huaite mihing hihnin ahi zaw hi.
Kuapeuh zakna ding bil nei in, za hen!" achi hi.
Mipite inn a alutsan nung in anungzuite'n gentehna thu amah adongchian uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Nou leng huchi tel a theihsiamna nei lou na hi uh maw? Bangpeuh polam a kipan a mihing sung a lut in amah ahihnin thei kei chih na thei kei ua hia?
Alungtang sung a lut lou a, agilpi sung a alut zawk ziak in leh dailenna a pawtkhe mai ahih ziak in," achi a. (Huai tuh an chiteng asiang, achihna ahi).
"Mihing sung a pan hong pawt, huai ngeingei in mihing ahihnin nak ahi.
Mihingte sunglam lungtang a kipan in, ngaihtuahna giloute ahong pawt nak hi;
kingaihna, guktakna, tualthahna, angkawmna leh enna, gitlouhna, khemhatna, bevenna, hazatna gensiatna, kisaktheihna leh haihuainate ahi.
Hiai thil giloute tengteng sunglam a kipan ahong pawt a, mihing ahihnin nak hi,” achi hi.
Huan athou a, huai a kipan in Tura leh Sidon uk ah apaita hi. Inn ah alut a, kuamah theih adeih kei a; himahleh akisel thei tuan kei.
heading: Zentel Numei Hihdamna / (Mat 15.21-28)

paite: Huchi in numei khat, atanu naupang chik dawi nin pai in, atanchin ana za a, akhebul ah abokkhup hi.
Huai numei tuh Grik mi ahi a, Sirophoinisia gam a piang ahi. Ama'n atanu sung a kipan a dawi delhkhe ding in angen hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Tate hong vah masa uhen aw; tate tanghou laksak a uite kiang a paih kilawm lou ahi,” achi hi.
Numei in akiang ah, "Toupa, hih zaw ahi na a, himahleh dohkan nuai a uite'n leng tate tanghou nen ane zel sam ve uah oi," chi in adawng hi.
Ama'n, akiang ah, "Na thugen ziak in paita in; na tanu sung a kipan dawi apawtta hi,” achi hi.
Huan a-inn ah apaita, atanu, dawi in apawtkhiaksan, lupna a lum ava muta hi.
Huan Tura gam a kipan apawt nawn a, Sidon khua tawn in Dekapolis gam paikan in Galili tuipi atungta hi.
heading: Bilngong Pau Thei Lou Hihdamna

paite: Mi khat nangong, pau leng pau kichian thei lou akiang ah hon tonpih ua, atung a khut koih ding in angen uhi.
Ama'n mipi lak a kipan in amah kia in apituam a, akhutzungte in abilsung akhoih a, chil sia in alei akhoihsak hi.
Van lam en in akhoisa huthut hi. Huan akiang ah, "Ephatha," achi a; huai bel, "Kihongta in," chihna ahi.
Huchi in abilte hong kihong a, aleigakna leng ahong kiphel a, chiantak in apau theita hi.
Akiang uah, kuamah hilh lou ding achi bikbek a; himahleh anak kham peuhleh, anak tangkoupihzaw sem uhi.
"Ama'n bangkim hoihtak in ahih a; nangongte nangawn apausak zel," achi ua, lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
